description: Docs gap: PATCH /workers/scripts/{script_name}/settings requires multipart/form-data with the settings JSON as a `settings` form part (the docs model it as a plain JSON PATCH with no body member, and the live API rejects that with ContentTypeRequired). The part is the documented settings object (ScriptsScriptAndVersionSettingsEditRequestSettings), so its members map to wire names by schema and json/props binding content keeps its keys (see bindingContent.manual.json); Workers for Platforms types its settings part the same way.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Worker settings to patch (bindings, tags, tail consumers, ...), JSON-encoded as the multipart `settings` part.
